data.title: Meduza: More than 700,000 Russian troops died in the war in Ukraine by late September 2026, Meduza and Mediazona estimate
data.summary: On November 1, news broke that hackers from the Belarusian Cyber Partisans and Silent Crow had breached the website of Rosstat, Russia’s federal statistics agency, and obtained data on Russian military losses in the war through fall 2026. The hackers used that data to produce their own estimate of how many Russians had been killed on the front lines. They also shared the database with reporters, including those at Meduza and Mediazona, which have been tracking Russia’s military death toll together for several years. We examined the hacked database and concluded that it was very likely authentic. We then compared its records with other sources and ran a new analysis. Our earlier studies relied mainly on data from the Register of Inheritance Cases. The Rosstat database makes the new estimate more reliable. Another important change: The new estimate counts both registered deaths and missing service members, many of whom will likely be confirmed dead.
